title: Marlowe & Finch Unlimited Courtesy on Delivery Claims Wrong-Item Keep Charges
content:
Membership benefit note for Delivery Claims: holders of a Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plan receive a courtesy on the charge for a wrong item they keep.

**Courtesy.** The Unlimited keep courtesy depends on the customer's Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership: an Unlimited Next-Day Annual, Express Annual or Express Monthly plan in status trial, active or cancellation pending gives 5%; any other Unlimited plan in one of those statuses gives 3%; a customer with no such membership gets none.

| Unlimited plan | Status trial, active or cancellation pending | Any other status |
|---|---|---|
| Unlimited Next-Day Annual | 5% | none |
| Unlimited Express Annual | 5% | none |
| Unlimited Express Monthly | 5% | none |
| Unlimited Standard Monthly | 3% | none |
| Unlimited Student Annual | 3% | none |
| Unlimited Standard Annual | 3% | none |
| no Unlimited membership | none | none |

Plan and status are read from the customer's Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership record.

*Hypothetical:* an Unlimited Student Annual member in trial keeps a wrong item: 3%. The same member after moving to Unlimited Express Monthly, active: 5%.
